# The Koan of the Empty Cup

## The Koan of the Empty Cup

> status: proposed
> kind: koan

*"A novice came to the master with a cup already full of his own opinions.
The master poured tea into the cup until it overflowed. 'Like this,' he said,
'you cannot receive my teaching while your cup is full.'"*
